items.name: Strong's Greek & Hebrew Dictionary
items.desc: 14,197 full lexical entries (definition + etymology + KJV usage). Every Strong's number in the reader opens a complete definition.

items.name: Abbott-Smith Greek Lexicon
items.desc: 10,847 New-Testament Greek entries (Abbott-Smith), keyed to Strong's numbers — tap any Greek word in the reader for its definition.

items.name: Brown–Driver–Briggs Hebrew Lexicon
items.desc: 8,181 Hebrew & Aramaic entries from Brown–Driver–Briggs, keyed to Strong's numbers — tap any Hebrew word in the reader for its definition.

items.name: Word Definitions (WordNet)
items.desc: Plain-English meanings for the words in the Bible you read, on any translation. Tap a verse, then Define. Downloads the first time you use it.

items.name: Word Definitions (Webster 1913)
items.desc: Older, richer meanings from Webster’s 1913 dictionary — closer to the language of the KJV. When installed, Define uses it first and falls back to WordNet.

items.name: Greek New Testament (original words)
items.desc: The Greek text of the New Testament, word by word, with each word's transliteration, Strong's number and grammar (STEPBible TAGNT). Download only if you want the original language.

items.name: Hebrew Old Testament (original words)
items.desc: The Hebrew text of the Old Testament, word by word, with each word's transliteration, Strong's number and grammar (STEPBible TAHOT). Download only if you want the original language.
